segments.name: Overseas art study services
segments.description: Provides educational services for students in China interested in applying for overseas art study.
segments.evidence: The Group classified the operating segments for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025 into (i) Overseas art study services (ii) Other educational services and (iii) Other services.

segments.name: Other educational services
segments.description: Provides other educational services, including research-based and project-based learning offerings.
segments.evidence: The Group classified the operating segments for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025 into (i) Overseas art study services (ii) Other educational services and (iii) Other services.

segments.name: Other services
segments.description: Provides other services not classified as overseas art study or other educational services.
segments.evidence: The Group classified the operating segments for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025 into (i) Overseas art study services (ii) Other educational services and (iii) Other services.

revenueModel.text: Students and clients in China pay the company for educational services such as portfolio training, research-based learning and overseas study counselling.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary business operations, including our portfolio training business, research-based learning services, overseas study counselling services and other educational services, are conducted primarily through our PRC subsidiary Huanqiuyimeng and its subsidiaries.
